facts.fact: The UNECA/GIZ/AU inception report says Banco de Moçambique Notice 4/GGBM/2003 requires data centres to be located in Mozambique, with replicas abroad allowed only with prior approval; it gives no repeal, and no date other than the 2003 notice and the report's publication of 2025-06-19.
